facts.text: I am trying to organize my loyalty programs and rewards.
I have a Walgreens Balance Rewards $5 reward that expires on October 15th.
I have a $5 coupon from CVS Pharmacy that is good on a purchase of $15 or more.
I have a 20% off entire purchase coupon from Bed Bath & Beyond that expires on November 1st.
I have been a member of the Bed Bath & Beyond loyalty program for a while.
I think I have been a member of the Walgreens Balance Rewards program for over a year.
I need to check my rewards balance on my Starbucks app.
I think I have a free drink reward waiting for me on my Starbucks app.
I earned a $10 reward on my Dick's Sporting Goods SCORECARD rewards program.
I got the Dick's Sporting Goods $10 reward by spending over $200 in the past 90 days on sporting goods and apparel.
I need to keep track of my points on my H&M loyalty card.
I have earned 100 points on my H&M loyalty card.
My 100 H&M loyalty points are halfway to getting a $5 reward.

events.text: CVS Pharmacy $5 coupon added (good on $15+ purchase)
Bed Bath & Beyond 20% off entire purchase coupon expires
Check Starbucks app rewards balance for a free drink reward
Earned Dick's Sporting Goods SCORECARD $10 reward
H&M loyalty card points progress toward $5 reward
